basis: Actual read-only live8771 selected owner facts, full selected cut; no provider/source writes

limitations: Counts include each original writing-tool-read/action/failure row once. Read baselines, context bookkeeping, and reply action copies are excluded.
Durations, response bytes, and context tokens are reported only when the tool row recorded them. Storage bytes are exact journal-line bytes.
